assertion.statement: Karpenter v1.0.0 now uses NodeClaim annotations instead of NodeClass annotations.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: the note names only the NodeClaim and NodeClass kinds; it gives no annotation keys, field paths, API group, or owning component, so no family identity can be spelled; applicability: no exposure condition can be derived from the note: it does not identify which annotation keys, which resources, or which configuration state trigger the new behavior; consequence: the note does not state what happens to an environment that relied on NodeClass annotations (whether they stop being honoured, require migration, or merely behave differently)
